a: System prompts set identity, style, and hard constraints.
Show input/output examples to steer format and quality.
Ask for stepwise reasoning when helpful; hide internal chain if needed.
Request JSON matching a schema for reliable parsing.
Provide source snippets and instruct the model to cite them.
Describe available tools and when to call them clearly.
Use clear delimiters around untrusted user content.
State disallowed categories explicitly in the system prompt.
Lower temperature for factual/coding; higher for brainstorming.
Improve prompts using a fixed evaluation set, not vibes alone.
